question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 1
question: Section 19(1a) of the Bank and Other Financial Institutions Act (BOFIA) 2020 states that a Bank shall not grant more than what percentage of its shareholders' funds unimpaired by losses to a company, its subsidiaries and associates?
discussion: Selected Answer: B. Confirmed against section 5.3.2 – the percentage (20%) is unchanged but the citation is now Section 19(1a) of BOFIA 2020.

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 2
question: Section 19 (1a) of the Bank and Other Financial Institutions Act (BOFIA) 2020, as amended, states that a Bank shall not grant more than 50% of its shareholders' funds unimpaired by losses to a company, its subsidiaries and associates.
discussion: Selected Answer: B. False — CPG §5.3.2: the correct limit is 20%, not 50%. (Also corrected citation: current law is BOFIA 2020 §19(1a); the prior stem cited the obsolete 'BOFIA 1991' and wrong section number.)

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 3
question: What concept describes the BOFIA requirement that a Bank shall not grant more than 20% of its shareholders' funds unimpaired by losses to a company, its subsidiaries and associates?
discussion: Selected Answer: D. Confirmed – this is the One Obligor concept (section 5.3.2).

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 4
question: At Access Bank, the concept of one obligor is extended to include any company belonging to a group whose management are strongly linked by virtue of their related ownership structure, particularly where the business fortune of one entity affects the other
discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed verbatim against section 5.3.2.

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 5
question: With regard to the one obligor limit, it shall be the responsibility of the Board of Directors to determine whether related company obligations shall be aggregated, and the basis for their decision shall be documented
discussion: Selected Answer: B. False – responsibility is with the Approving Officers, not the Board (section 5.3.2).

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 6
question: As a guide, the term 'One Obligor' to a borrower includes all subsidiaries owned at least 50%, such interest to be an aggregate of both direct and indirect shareholding
discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed verbatim against section 5.3.2.

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 7
question: As a guide, the term 'One Obligor' to a borrower includes any less-than-50%-owned affiliate where the borrower exercises management control, and where the affiliate's commercial fortunes are strongly influenced by the borrower
discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed verbatim against section 5.3.2.

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 8
question: As a guide, the term 'One Obligor' to a borrower includes any obligor related to the borrower as a result of guarantees, endorsements, or other similar arrangements in favour of the Bank
discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed verbatim against section 5.3.2.

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 9
question: As a guide, the term 'One Obligor' to a borrower includes all obligors under common ownership or control of a corporation or individual
discussion: Selected Answer: A. Confirmed verbatim against section 5.3.2.

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 10
question: When establishing Total Facilities for a relationship, credit facilities to affiliates owned between 20% and 50% (where the borrower effectively controls the affiliate) should be:

options.A: Included in Total Facilities for the relationship
options.B: Always excluded from Total Facilities regardless of control
options.C: Only included if the affiliate is listed on a stock exchange
options.D: Only included with the affiliate's own separate Board approval

discussion: Selected Answer: A. Section 5.3.6: Total Facilities 'should also include credit facilities to affiliates (up to 20% but less than 50% owned) where the borrower effectively controls' the affiliate.
community_answer: A. Included in Total Facilities for the relationship

question: At Access Bank, exposure against Risk Rating Limits is measured as the Outstandings and Unused Commitments ('OSUC') to a given relationship

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 12
question: OSUC is the sum of all Outstandings (including Direct and Contingent Exposure) against Total Facilities, as well as the unused portion of any Committed Facility included in Total Facilities

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 19

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 23
question: All RRLEs not captured under Cash, Immaterial, or Passive Exceptions are classified as:

question_no: One Obligor Limit, Exposure (OSUC) & Risk Rating Limit Exceptions - Question 121
question: Although distribution efforts are similar to an underwriting, a Best Efforts undertaking also entails a legal commitment to fund any distribution shortfall. However, there is risk here in the franchise damage associated with a failed undertaking.

The risk instead is franchise/reputational damage if the undertaking fails, not a funding obligation.
